The prior execution failed because the shell command’s nested quoting was unbalanced. I’m rerunning the exact finite-state calculation with safer quoting, and I’ll report only the maximizing ball.
I’m using the stated rule literally: a ball wins only when its own piston fires; a ball that merely rolls away from position one does not win. The recurrence stops once all real balls have left the platform, while non-real filler values keep the last transitions well-defined.
3
